title: DID-method extension — did:webvh
description:
Schema for the `ext.vnd.trusttasks.did-method-webvh` extension object. When a did-management operation declares `payload.method = "webvh"`, the producer MAY include this extension at any depth that accepts `ext` (top-level payload, DidRecord, DomainEntry, etc.) to carry webvh-specific metadata. Consumers that aren't webvh-aware MUST ignore unknown namespaces per SPEC.md §4.5.1.

Status: draft, evolves with the did:webvh method specification (W3C `did-web-vh` draft).

scid.description: Self-certifying identifier derived from the initial log entry. Identifies the DID independent of its hosting URL.

updateKeyMultibase.description: Multibase-encoded Ed25519 public key currently authorised to sign log entries (`parameters.updateKeys[0]`).

nextKeyHashes.description: Hashes of next-allowed update keys, when the chain commits to a pre-rotation key set.

witnessUrls.description: URLs of witness services that can attest to the log chain.

witnessThreshold.description: Minimum witness count for a valid attestation.

latestVersionId.description: VersionId of the most recent published log entry.

portable.description: When true, the chain is hosted under a portable identifier and may be moved between hosting URLs without changing the canonical DID.

deactivated.description: True iff the latest log entry deactivates the DID per the webvh deactivation protocol.
